instructions.name: create_root_vault
docs: Create a new options vault.
vault_side = 0: LONG vault → long_mint = CALL@strike, short_mint = FLOOR@strike
vault_side = 1: SHORT vault → long_mint = CAP@strike,  short_mint = PUT@strike

instructions.name: merge_claims
docs: Merge two child claims back into their parent (pre or post-expiry,
blocked only if settlement_price is already locked).

instructions.name: redeem_root
docs: Pre-expiry redemption: burns equal LONG + SHORT, returns proportional collateral.

instructions.name: settle_vault
docs: Post-expiry settlement: burns one side (0=long/CALL, 1=short/FLOOR)
and pays out based on oracle vs strike.

accounts.name: caller_token_ata
docs: The caller's token ATA: must be for long_mint (side=0) or short_mint (side=1).
Validated at runtime. token::authority = caller only checked here.

instructions.name: split_claim
docs: Split a root claim or child claim into two sub-claims at child_strike.
Blocked after vault expiry or after settlement_price is locked.

types.name: ClaimNode
docs: Records one split event in the fractal claim tree.
Each node represents the creation of two child tokens (left = higher claim,
right = bounded claim) by burning a parent token at a specific child_strike.
Seeds: ["claim_node", root_vault, node_id.to_le_bytes()]

fields.name: parent_strike
docs: Strike price of the parent token being split.

fields.name: child_strike
docs: Strike price encoded into the new child tokens.
left_child = CALL/CAP above child_strike
right_child = FLOOR/PUT bounded at child_strike

types.name: NonceLedger
docs: Prevents order-replay in settle_trade.
Seeds: ["nonce", trader, nonce.to_le_bytes()]

types.name: OptionMergedEvent
docs: Emitted when child tokens are merged back into a parent token.
Field order + types exactly match OptionMergedEventRaw in the indexer.

types.name: OptionSettledEvent
docs: Emitted when a vault is settled post-expiry (one side at a time).
Event name "OptionSettledEvent" matches the indexer's discriminator lookup.
Field order + types exactly match OptionSettledEventRaw in the indexer.

types.name: OptionSplitEvent
docs: Emitted when a claim token is split into two child tokens.
Field order + types exactly match OptionSplitEventRaw in the indexer.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Global protocol configuration.
Seeds: ["protocol_config"]

types.name: RedeemEvent
docs: Emitted when a vault token is redeemed pre-expiry for collateral (both sides).

types.name: RootVault
docs: Root vault: holds deposited collateral and tracks CALL (long) + FLOOR/PUT (short) mints.
Semantics:
vault_side = 0  (LONG):  long_mint = CALL@strike,  short_mint = FLOOR@strike
vault_side = 1  (SHORT): long_mint = CAP@strike,   short_mint = PUT@strike
Pre-expiry:  split_claim / merge_claims / redeem_root (burns both sides equally)
Post-expiry: settle_vault (burns one side, pays based on oracle vs strike)
Seeds: ["root_vault", owner, vault_id.to_le_bytes()]

fields.name: strike_price
docs: Strike price in micro-USD (6 decimals). e.g. $150.00 = 150_000_000.

fields.name: expiry_ts
docs: Unix timestamp after which settle_vault becomes available.

fields.name: vault_side
docs: 0 = LONG vault (CALL/FLOOR), 1 = SHORT vault (CAP/PUT).

fields.name: settlement_price
docs: Oracle price locked on the first settle_vault call (0 = not yet settled).

fields.name: settled_call_total
docs: Total collateral allocated to the LONG (CALL/CAP) token pool.
Locked on first settle_vault call; NEVER updated afterwards.
Payout per CALL token = amount × settled_call_total / settled_long_supply.

fields.name: settled_floor_total
docs: Total collateral allocated to the SHORT (FLOOR/PUT) token pool.
settled_call_total + settled_floor_total == collateral at lock time.

fields.name: settled_long_supply
docs: long_mint.supply at the moment settlement was locked.

fields.name: settled_short_supply
docs: short_mint.supply at the moment settlement was locked.

types.name: SignedOrder
docs: Signed order for off-chain orderbook settlement.
The Ed25519 signature covers the 97-byte serialized message:
trader(32) || token_mint(32) || side(1) || quantity(8) || price(8) || nonce(8) || expires_at(8)

fields.name: side
docs: 0 = Buy, 1 = Sell

fields.name: price
docs: USDC lamports per token (6 decimals)

fields.name: signature
docs: Ed25519 signature for audit; on-chain enforcement uses Signer constraint

types.name: TradeEvent
docs: Emitted when an on-chain trade is settled atomically.

types.name: VaultCreatedEvent
docs: Emitted when a new root vault is created.
Field order + types must EXACTLY match VaultCreatedEventRaw in the indexer.
borsh try_from_slice fails on trailing bytes, so keep this lean.
